categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/net_processing.cpp` by breaking up `PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage()` into per-message handlers.
categories.rationale: Decomposing the monolithic `ProcessMessage()` function improves navigation and scoping across P2P message handlers, but it is an internal refactoring without behavioral impact. Reviewers agree that it 'makes it easier to navigate net_processing and better encapsulates logic', but it does not fix bugs or address protocol hazards.
